paper.title: Non-standard Verma type modules for $\fq(n)^{(2)}$
paper.abstract: We study non-standard Verma type modules over the Kac-Moody queer Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{q}(n)^{(2)}$. We give a sufficient condition under which such modules are irreducible. We also give a classification of all irreducible diagonal $\mathbb{Z}$-graded modules over certain Heisenberg Lie superalgebras contained in $\mathfrak{q}(n)^{(2)}$.
